title: Preserving malignant provenance in single-cell cancer atlases: lessons from Ewing sarcoma plasticity.
snippet: Single-cell atlases increasingly organize tumors according to recurrent transcriptional states, but state-based integration can weaken or obscure the molecular evidence that distinguishes malignant from non-malignant provenance.
